# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-api-reference.py from the backend's and the Session Agent's
     route tables. Do not edit by hand: change the code and run the script. CI fails when this
     file is out of date. -->

Every HTTP route of the backend and the Session Agent, generated from the code. For what the
endpoints mean and how they fit together, see [api.md](api.md) and the guides it links. Full
JSON schemas are also served by a running backend at `/api/openapi.json`.

- **Paths** are the backend's own. Through the reverse proxy they are under `/api/`, e.g.
  `POST /auth/login` is `https://<host>/api/auth/login`.
- **Access**: `ADMIN` / `SECURITY_REVIEWER` / `USER` are roles; "any logged-in user" needs a
  session cookie (`openrbi_session`) of any role. A state-changing request also needs the
  CSRF header ([security-model.md](security-model.md#csrf-protection-rbi-post-003)).
- **Listener**: which `OPENRBI_LISTENER_MODE` serves the route — `shared` (every mode), `user`
  (`user` and `both`) or `admin` (`admin` and `both`); see
  [ADR 0011](adr/0011-user-admin-listener-separation.md).
- A field marked `?` in [Schemas](#schemas) is optional.

## Session Agent (internal)

Reachable only from the control plane, never through the reverse proxy
([ADR 0004](adr/0004-separate-session-agent.md)). Requests carry the `X-Openrbi-Agent-Token`
header; the `admin` scope is a superset of `user`
([ADR 0025](adr/0025-segmented-credential-scoping.md)).

### `/health`

| Endpoint | Access | Parameters | Success response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /health`<br>Health | public (liveness only) | — | `200` map of string |

### `/v1/nodes`

| Endpoint | Access | Parameters | Success response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /v1/nodes/self`<br>Node status | agent token, `user` scope | — | `200` map of string or integer or number or boolean |

## Schemas

### Backend

- **AdminSessionResponse**: `id` uuid, `status` string, `browser` string, `sandbox_backend` string, `display_backend` string, `cpu_limit` number, `ram_limit_mb` integer, `pid_limit` integer, `disk_limit_mb` integer, `screen_width` integer, `screen_height` integer, `clipboard_mode` string, `created_at` datetime, `started_at` datetime or null, `ended_at` datetime or null, `user_id` uuid, `username` string, `node_id?` uuid or null, `worker_hostname?` string or null
- **BrowserNodeResponse**: `id` uuid, `hostname` string, `status` string, `enrollment_status` string, `endpoint_url` string or null, `health` string, `capacity` integer, `capacity_bound` string or null, `ram_capacity` integer or null, `cpu_capacity` integer or null, `active_sessions` integer, `runtime` string, `version` string or null, `last_heartbeat` datetime or null, `cpu_percent` number or null, `ram_total_mb` integer or null, `ram_used_mb` integer or null, `uptime_seconds` integer or null
- **ChangePasswordRequest**: `current_password` string, `new_password` string
- **ComponentHealthResponse**: `name` string, `status` string, `detail` string or null
- **CreateGroupRequest**: `name` string, `description?` string or null
- **CreatePolicyRequest**: `name` string, `policy_type` string, `description?` string or null
- **CreateUserRequest**: `username` string, `password` string, `role` string, `group_ids?` list of uuid
- **CreateVersionRequest**: `content?` map of any, `file_rules?` list of `FileRuleInput`
- **CurrentUserResponse**: `id` uuid, `username` string, `role` string, `mfa_enabled` boolean, `auth_source` string, `created_at` datetime
- **DashboardKpisResponse**: `active_sessions` integer, `active_sessions_delta_last_hour` integer or null, `workers_healthy` integer, `workers_total` integer, `system_health` string, `avg_cpu_percent` number or null, `avg_ram_percent` number or null, `users` integer, `files_processed_24h` integer, `blocked_files_24h` integer, `incidents_24h` integer
- **DashboardResponse**: `generated_at` datetime, `telemetry_stale` boolean, `kpis` `DashboardKpisResponse`, `session_history` list of `SessionHistoryPointResponse`, `workers` list of `WorkerSummaryResponse`, `warnings` list of `DashboardWarningResponse`, `file_statuses_24h` list of `FileStatusSummaryResponse`, `quarantine_pending` integer, `quarantine_high_risk` integer, `recent_incidents` list of `RecentIncidentResponse`
- **DashboardWarningResponse**: `kind` string, `message` string, `worker_hostname` string or null, `username` string or null
- **DownloadTokenResponse**: `token` string, `expires_in_seconds` integer
- **EnrollConfirmRequest**: `code` string
- **EnrollConfirmResponse**: `recovery_codes` list of string
- **EnrollResponse**: `otpauth_uri` string, `qr_code_png_base64` string
- **FileRuleInput**: `rule_type` string, `match_pattern` string, `action` string, `priority?` integer
- **FileRuleResponse**: `id` uuid, `rule_type` string, `match_pattern` string, `action` string, `priority` integer
- **FileStatusSummaryResponse**: `status` string, `count` integer
- **GroupDetail**: `id` uuid, `name` string, `description` string or null, `member_count` integer, `created_at` datetime, `policies` list of `PolicyRef`, `members` list of `UserRef`
- **GroupOverviewItem**: `id` uuid, `name` string, `description` string or null, `member_count` integer, `policies` list of string, `created_at` datetime
- **GroupOverviewResponse**: `items` list of `GroupOverviewItem`, `total` integer, `offset` integer, `limit` integer, `stats` `GroupOverviewStats`
- **GroupOverviewStats**: `total` integer, `memberships` integer, `with_policies` integer
- **GroupRef**: `id` uuid, `name` string
- **GroupSummary**: `id` uuid, `name` string, `description` string or null, `member_count` integer
- **HTTPValidationError**: `detail?` list of `ValidationError`
- **IncidentResponse**: `id` uuid, `severity` string, `status` string, `title` string, `description` string, `user_id` uuid or null, `session_id` uuid or null, `quarantine_file_id` uuid or null, `assigned_to` uuid or null, `resolution` string or null, `created_at` datetime, `updated_at` datetime
- **LdapConfigResponse**: `enabled` boolean, `server_uri` string, `use_starttls` boolean, `bind_dn` string, `bind_password_configured` boolean, `base_dn` string, `user_search_filter` string, `group_attribute` string, `group_role_mapping` map of string, `updated_by` uuid or null
- **LdapConfigUpdateRequest**: `server_uri` string, `use_starttls` boolean, `bind_dn` string, `base_dn` string, `user_search_filter` string, `group_attribute` string, `enabled` boolean, `bind_password?` string or null, `group_role_mapping?` map of string
- **LdapTestRequest**: `server_uri` string, `use_starttls` boolean, `bind_dn` string, `base_dn` string, `user_search_filter` string, `group_attribute` string, `bind_password` string, `test_username?` string or null
- **LdapTestResponse**: `success` boolean, `steps` list of `LdapTestStepResponse`, `groups_discovered` integer or null
- **LdapTestStepResponse**: `name` string, `ok` boolean, `detail` string or null
- **LockoutStatus**: `locked` boolean, `failure_count` integer, `locked_seconds_remaining` integer or null
- **LoginRequest**: `username` string, `password` string
- **LoginResponse**: `status` string, `mfa_token?` string or null
- **MfaVerifyRequest**: `mfa_token` string, `code` string
- **NodeApproveRequest**: `endpoint_url` string
